subject: polity
title: Borrowed Features of the Constitution
description: Features borrowed from other countries' constitutions

content.overview: The Indian Constitution borrowed features from various countries' constitutions, making it a unique blend.
keyPoints: UK: Parliamentary system, Rule of Law, Single citizenship, Cabinet system
USA: Fundamental Rights, Judicial Review, Independent judiciary, Preamble
Ireland: Directive Principles of State Policy, Presidential election method
Canada: Federal system, Residual powers to Centre, Supreme Court advisory jurisdiction
Australia: Concurrent List, Trade and commerce provisions, Joint sitting of Parliament
Germany: Suspension of Fundamental Rights during Emergency
South Africa: Amendment of Constitution, Election of Rajya Sabha members
USSR: Fundamental Duties, Five Year Plans
France: Republic, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity in Preamble

mnemonics.explanation: UK (Parliamentary), USA (FRs), Ireland (DPSP), Canada (Federal), Australia (Concurrent), Germany (Emergency), USSR (Duties), France (Preamble), Japan (Procedure)
